flags.why: Rám nắng means tanned by the sun, whereas sunburnt suggests skin damaged by sunlight.
flags.fix: He has a rugged, suntanned look.

flags.why: Thanh âm means sound without requiring it to be pleasing to the ear, as confirmed by the [dictionary definition](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-thanh%20%C3%A2m).
Đường đột is used naturally in everyday conversation, so the formal tag misleadingly restricts its use.
The example explains the letter name instead of using it in context.
flags.fix: Biển số xe có chữ giê ở cuối. = The vehicle's license plate has a G at the end.

flags.why: The example defines bất hại instead of showing its use.
flags.fix: Ông thực hành bất hại bằng cách tránh sát sinh. = He practices ahimsa by avoiding killing living beings.

flags.why: Thần minh is literary vocabulary that learners would not normally use for gods in casual conversation.
The weather sense is Central Vietnamese usage and needs a regional label, as illustrated by [usage in Huế](https://blogdulichdanang.com/xung-va-mua-hue-cai-thu-vui-cua-nguoi-xu-hue-moi-mua-mua).
